rules.accepted_credit_types: APA-approved activities; in-person or online training by state/national professional organizations (AMA, NASW, ACA, etc.); in-service with psychological content (max 10 h); academic courses (max 10 h); teaching/publishing (max 10 h each); first-time presentations (max 5 h); board meeting attendance (max 5 h); approved home study with exam (max 10 h)
rules.new_licensee_rule: CE is waived for licensees licensed in Arkansas less than one calendar year on the June 30 due date.
rules.audit_note: Random annual audit; documentation due within 30 days of request ($50 late fee on first failure).
rules.notes: Applies to psychologists and licensed psychological examiners. Accrual period July 1 - June 30; licenses active July 1 - June 30. CE may be in person or online; home study from journals/books capped at 10 h. Reading and routine supervision do not count.
